source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Both host documents append data: to img-src while preserving the other directives. Keep that image-source exception separate from permissions for scripts, styles and the embedded message body. The report concerns a contact photo blocked as data:image, but the patch author says they could not test that input. These declarations remain in accepted source; avatar output and native enforcement were not run.
title: The three-pane and message host CSP add data only to image sources
